text:
deploybot: Canary started for release v3.9.1 to us-west-2 (10% traffic). p95 CPU latency spike detected: 1400ms (threshold 900ms). rolling window: 3m
maya: seeing it in dashboard, p95 is trending up across two host pools
aj: oncall here — what's the rollback policy for canary p95 breaches? auto or manual?
maya: deploybot rule would auto-rollback at sustained 3m breach, but this is borderline. prefer manual given customer traffic
kai: agree with manual. also noticed increased evictions in dedicated-pool-7
maya: ops-eng can you drain canary slice and freeze new rollouts? :eyes:
ops-eng: starting drain now: `kubectl cordon node/node-37` then `kubectl drain node/node-37 --ignore-daemonsets` — will stop new canary pods
lydia: PM note: hold customer-facing release notes until we resolve; don't push change log public
aj: if we manually rollback, do we pin previous model version or do a rollback to previous image? what's safer?
maya: rollback plan: revert traffic slice to v3.9.0 image, pin deploy service to 3.9.0 for 1h, then run smoke tests
kai: commands:
```
kubectl set image deployment/redwood-inference redwood=reg.example.com/redwood:3.9.0
kubectl rollout status deployment/redwood-inference
```
ops-eng: running `kubectl set image` now
deploybot: Canary latency improved to 920ms after drain start (approx 90s) — monitoring
maya: still above threshold 900ms but trending down. give it 3 more minutes
aj: recommend manual rollback if p95 > 950ms at T+5m
lydia: alert comms draft (internal only): "Brief outage risk during rollback for small % of requests; customer impact minimal. Notifying SSO owners." I'll draft external note if we execute rollback
ops-eng: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-inference --to-revision=42` ready if approved
maya: vote: manual rollback now? I vote yes to avoid cascading cache thrash
kai: +1
aj: +1 on manual rollback. I'll oversee verification
lydia: I'll prepare short external blurb: "Investigating perf regression; if rollback occurs customers may see brief increased latency as we roll traffic back." will hold until exec confirms
maya: exec: perform rollback, pin to 3.9.0, run smoke suite, update release notes to note rollback and fix plan
ops-eng: executing rollback... `rollout undo` in progress
deploybot: Rollout completed. pods 0->3 v3.9.0. p95 now 610ms
aj: running smoke tests: endpoint /v1/generate OK, latency stable
maya: updating release notes draft and adding internal postmortem ticket
lydia: external comms ready to send if needed. tagging trust team
aj: closing loop: manual rollback executed, pinned for 1h, follow-up RCA scheduled. Great job team :thumbsup:
